title: MIDI LOOPBACK
author: irpina
description: An internal MIDI cable for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys: what the MIDI tracks send on the chosen channel goes back into the unit instead of out, as if it came in on DIN, so a MIDI track can sequence and p-lock the Digitone's own tracks and its master effects (set its channel to a track's or the FX channel and its CCs to the parameters' CC numbers). LOOPBACK in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) picks the channel, OFF or 1-16, saved with the project. Applied from the UI task, up to a frame (33 ms) after the step. OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 5.0.1.
